# ZeFile

> ZeFile is a file-delivery platform built for African creators. Senders upload work, set a price, and recipients pay before they can download. Watermarked previews protect originals until payment lands. Free up to 5 GB.

## What ZeFile is

ZeFile is a payment-protected file transfer service. It combines large file sharing (similar to WeTransfer) with a paywall: recipients can preview a watermarked version of every file, but the originals stay locked until they pay. Senders receive funds via Mobile Money (MTN, Orange Money, Wave), bank transfer, USSD, or card.

The product targets freelancers and creative professionals in West and Central Africa who deliver finished work — photos, videos, audio, design files, documents — and need to get paid before handing over the originals.

## Key facts

- Free plan: send up to 5 GB per transfer, 14-day expiry, $0/month
- Paid plans: Starter and Pro unlock larger transfers, longer expiry, lower platform fees
- Platform fees: 7% (Free), 5% (Starter), 3% (Pro) deducted from creator earnings
- Payouts: Mobile Money or bank transfer (MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money, Wave, plus West African bank rails)
- Supported file types: photos, videos, audio, design files, documents, archives — any file type
- Watermarked previews on all images, videos, audio (originals stay locked until payment)
- Version history: upload revisions to the same link, recipients always see the latest files
- Languages: English, French
- Founded: 2026
- Domains: zefile.io (main), zefile.co (short links), api.zefile.io (API), cdn.zefile.io (file CDN)
